from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DeferredTaxLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the Deferred Tax Liability data extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as found in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the Deferred Tax Liability")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the financial report covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    deferred_tax_liabilities: list[DeferredTaxLiabilityRecord]
